title: Capitals of Africa
intro: Pick the capital city of each country in Africa.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of United Republic of Tanzania?
questions.explain: Dodoma is the capital of United Republic of Tanzania.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Botswana?
questions.explain: Gaborone is the capital of Botswana.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Cabo Verde?
questions.explain: Praia is the capital of Cabo Verde.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Guinea-Bissau?
questions.explain: Bissau is the capital of Guinea-Bissau.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Mauritania?
questions.explain: Nouakchott is the capital of Mauritania.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Democratic Republic of the Congo?
questions.explain: Kinshasa is the capital of Democratic Republic of the Congo.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Libya?
questions.explain: Tripoli is the capital of Libya.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.explain: Rabat is the capital of Morocco.
